help: Collection name in this node's storage (letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen). Each collection keeps one embedding model.
OpenAI-compatible API root; the block calls <base_url>/embeddings. Loopback servers (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM) work as is; other hosts need allow_remote.
Embedding model name sent to the endpoint. A collection refuses vectors from another model.
Optional wallet reference for a Bearer API key, e.g. secret://workspace/embeddings_key. Never paste the key itself.
Number of matches returned by a query (1–100). A query message may override it.
Minimum cosine similarity, from -1 to 1. Lower-scoring items are not returned.
Split texts into chunks of about this many characters, cut at whitespace. 0 keeps each text whole.
Characters repeated between consecutive chunks, at most half of chunk_size.
Allow delete messages (by ids, metadata filter or all). Off by default.
Text prepended to each query before embedding, for models that expect one (e.g. search_query: ).
Text prepended to each chunk before embedding (e.g. search_document: ). Not stored in the returned text.
Allow a non-loopback embeddings host (LAN or Internet). Off by default; link-local and metadata addresses stay blocked.
Allow plain HTTP to a non-loopback host. An API key is never sent this way.
Optional absolute path of a PEM CA file for an HTTPS endpoint with a private certificate authority.
Texts sent per embeddings request.
Total time allowed for one message, embeddings requests included.
Maximum stored items (chunks) in the collection. A message that would exceed it is rolled back.
Maximum characters sent to the model for one chunk or query.
Maximum size of one input message in bytes.
Maximum size of one embeddings response in bytes.
Maximum size of the collection file in MiB.
